label: eevee
instructions: Eevee: random Battle11Wild, Battle14Wild, or Battle22Wild. Repeat separate battles.

label: pikachu
instructions: Pikachu: appearance level-up alert; battle Battle13Rival.

label: mewtwo
instructions: Mewtwo: species beats the equal-priority legendary rule; Battle4Cynthia.

label: articuno
instructions: Articuno: random legendary track.

label: mew
instructions: Mew: mythical category, Battle24Colress.

label: nihilego
instructions: Nihilego: Ultra Beast category, Battle26LegendaryFadeout.

label: vulpix
instructions: Vulpix: generic species rule, Battle1.

label: vulpix_alola
instructions: Alolan Vulpix: form beats species, Battle21GymFadeout; item-pickup appearance alert.

label: rattata
instructions: Rattata: wild default now applies, Battle1. Use the no-rules variant for native fallback.

label: custom_category
instructions: Snorlax: custom boss category, Battle26LegendaryFadeout; firework appearance alert.

label: priority_override
instructions: Bulbasaur: higher-priority boss category beats its species rule, Battle26LegendaryFadeout.

label: shiny_rattata
instructions: Shiny Rattata: Battle24Colress in battle and a short pling on appearance.

label: intro
instructions: Magikarp: short toast intro then Battle11Wild. Wait for the intro to finish; unchanged F3+T must not replay it.

label: low_ally_hp
instructions: Magikarp: ally side at 20% or below -> Battle4Cynthia. Heal or switch the last low ally -> main from the beginning.

label: low_enemy_hp
instructions: Magikarp: opponent at 20% or below -> Battle24Colress. False Swipe can leave it at 1 HP without fainting.

label: both_low_hp
instructions: Both sides low: Battle4Cynthia wins. Recover the ally side -> Battle24Colress; recover enemy -> Battle11Wild, with no new intro.

label: ally_only
instructions: Caterpie configures only low_ally_hp. Low enemies do not change its Battle11Wild main track.

label: enemy_only
instructions: Weedle configures only low_enemy_hp. Low allies do not change its Battle11Wild main track.

label: missing_optional
instructions: Ditto: missing intro and ally tracks are skipped. A low enemy still plays Battle24Colress, including when both sides are low.

label: missing_main
instructions: Pidgey: missing main sound restores the normal Prisma wild pool; missing appearance alert is silent.

label: teammate / bench / faint exclusions
instructions: Requires a multi battle supplied by your battle setup. With a staged rule active, a living active teammate at <=20% triggers ally music. Benched and fainted allies/enemies must not trigger. Check both active slots in doubles.

label: give test Scyther
instructions: Added Scyther with False Swipe and Roost. Use False Swipe to bring an enemy below 20%; use Roost or battle items for ally recovery. This adds to your party and does not clear existing Pokemon.

label: trainer_exact
instructions: Spawned a level 10 trainer. Interact and accept its challenge. Exact class wins over prefixes: Battle4Cynthia.

label: trainer_prefix
instructions: Spawned a level 10 trainer. Interact and accept its challenge. Broad gym prefix: Battle10Legendary.

label: trainer_name
instructions: Spawned a level 10 trainer. Interact and accept its challenge. Exact display name: Battle13Rival; NPC Pokemon must not trigger appearances.

label: trainer_species_scope
instructions: Spawned a level 10 trainer. Interact and accept its challenge. Trainer-scoped Eevee: Battle22Wild, separate from wild Eevee.

label: trainer_default
instructions: Spawned a level 10 trainer. Interact and accept its challenge. No trainer-specific match: all default, Battle13Rival.

label: player_default
instructions: Requires a second participating player. Challenge a second player with a non-Eevee lead who matches neither configured target: Battle4Cynthia.

label: player_name
instructions: Requires a second participating player. Build with --player-name ACCOUNT and use the player-name variant to isolate username targeting: Battle24Colress. The complete pack UUID rule wins if both target the same opponent.

label: player_uuid
instructions: Requires a second participating player. Build with --player-uuid UUID and challenge that account: Battle21GymFadeout. Equal-priority UUID targeting beats the username rule.

label: player_species_scope
instructions: Requires a second participating player. Challenge a non-targeted second player with an Eevee active: player-scoped species rule, Battle14Wild.

label: spectator exclusion
instructions: Requires a second player already battling. Use /spectateBattle ACCOUNT to spectate. Custom battle rules must not apply; participating-player music should still work after you leave spectating.

label: spawn_species
instructions: Species alert: level-up sound.

label: spawn_shiny
instructions: Individual shiny alert: pling sound.

label: spawn_category
instructions: Custom category alert: firework twinkle.

label: spawn_form
instructions: Form-specific alert: item-pickup sound.

label: spawn_default
instructions: Wild default alert: experience-orb sound. Spawn matching is independent of battle music.

label: spawn_once
instructions: Spawn this UUID once, then walk away and return, unload chunks, change dimension, F3+T, reconnect, and restart. The same UUID stays silent; rerunning this helper makes a NEW UUID that may alert.

label: owned Pokemon exclusion
instructions: Added an owned shiny Rattata. Send it out: it must NOT play a wild appearance alert. NPC send-outs are also excluded.

label: all spawn selector
instructions: Rebuild with --variant spawn-all and activate that pack. A newly tracked wild Rattata uses the all spawn rule; owned/NPC Pokemon remain excluded. This helper only prints instructions.

label: wild spawn selector
instructions: Rebuild with --variant spawn-wild and activate that pack. A newly tracked wild Rattata uses the wild spawn rule. This helper only prints instructions.

label: reload and transfer
instructions: During Magikarp battle press F3+T unchanged: keep selected tracks without repeating intro. Edit/rebuild a rule, refresh the offered server pack by reconnecting, and check it updates. Transfer servers: pack rules disappear when that pack unloads.

label: unmatched native fallback
instructions: Rebuild with --variant no-rules, activate it without other rule packs, and battle Rattata. Native Prisma wild pool should play. The complete pack has an all default, so it cannot demonstrate no-match fallback.

label: history and unavailable audio
instructions: Pidgey tests missing appearance audio. For save-failure tests use a disposable client copy with an unwritable history folder; no appearance playback should occur. Preserve real histories; do not delete them to reset a test.

label: setup and diagnostics
instructions: Enable the updated client mod and accept the server resource pack. /reload refreshes this datapack; F3+T refreshes client resources. Enable DEBUG for cobblemon-custom-battle-music to see winning rules/stages. There is no server music config or battle-music reload command.
